summary:
Implementation completed and verified:
1. ELO rating deduction is fully functional when exchanging 50 ELO for 500 Mugen Gems, syncing to state and sessionStorage with live downward notifications.
2. In-store interactive 3-tap chest opening animation with Web Audio effects, wobbles, and golden reveal is connected to OPEN NOW.
3. SAVE TO TROPHY ROOM immediately records chests in the user vault, displaying them in both the store vault section and Trophy Room under Chests to Open.
